low-sun.intent: a quiet pale sun balances the tower

water-light.intent: a lighter sweep toward the foreground

far-island.intent: a low distant headland below the sun

rock-top.intent: the illuminated top plane supports the tower

tower-foot.intent: a pale footing visibly rests on the rock

tower-body.intent: ivory tower narrows toward the lantern

tower-side.intent: subordinate shadow plane on the tower right

lantern-frame.intent: dark frame holds the warm glass

lantern-glass.intent: the lit pane is the focal warm note

lantern-mullion.intent: a slim upright divides the glass

roof.intent: coral pitched roof crowns the lamp

door.intent: a grounded doorway meets the rocky platform

foreground-stone.intent: a dark rounded stone breaks the near water

water-ripple-a.intent: a thin pale ripple identifies the open water

water-ripple-b.intent: a second shorter ripple sits further out

near-ripple.intent: a short ripple separates the foreground stone from land
